sources.snippet: Gemma 4 31B It Assistant, built by Google, excels at tasks such as text generation, coding, and reasoning, leveraging its Dense and Mixture-of-Experts architectures. Notably, it features a context window of up to 262,144 tokens, allowing for extensive input processing.

sources.snippet: Overview gemma-4-31B-it-assistant is a specialized draft model designed for speculative decoding with the full Gemma 4 31B instruction-tuned model. Built by google, this is not a standalone model but rather a faster, smaller auxiliary component that predicts multiple tokens ahead while the target model verifies predictions in parallel. This architecture delivers up to 2x decoding speedups ...
